# KayKit — Character Pack: Skeletons 1.0 (CC0)

Rigged and animated skeleton characters and props by **Kay Lousberg** (https://www.kaylousberg.com,
https://kaylousberg.itch.io/kaykit-skeletons, GitHub `KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Character-Pack-Skeletons-1.0`).
License: **CC0 1.0** (see `LICENSE.txt` copied from the pack). Crediting "Kay Lousberg, www.kaylousberg.com" is
appreciated but not required.

Only the files `Blender/enemies_cc0/specs.py` uses are kept here:

| file | used for |
|---|---|
| `Characters/Skeleton_Minion.glb` (+ 90 clips, texture embedded) | skeleton |
| `Characters/Skeleton_Warrior.glb` | elite_skeleton |
| `Assets/Skeleton_Blade.gltf/.bin` | skeleton's sword (bound to `handslot.r`) |
| `Assets/Skeleton_Axe.gltf/.bin`, `Assets/Skeleton_Shield_Large_A.gltf/.bin` | elite_skeleton's axe and shield |
| `Assets/skeleton_texture.png` | gradient atlas referenced by the prop glTFs |

The Mage and Rogue skeletons and the other props are in the full pack at the URLs above.
